source.detail: removed beta webhook event data types (environment/memory_store families)

spec_evidence.checked: GitHub commit 5e7c431 (chore(api): remove some nonfunctional types from the SDKs) fetched via commits API and read file by file: 8 type modules deleted (beta_webhook_environment_{archived,created,deleted,updated}_event_data, beta_webhook_environment_deleted_event_type, beta_webhook_memory_store_{archived,created,deleted}_event_data), 24 re-exports dropped from types/beta/__init__.py, and beta_webhook_event_data.py no longer unions them. Upstream labels them nonfunctional: the event payloads were never emitted, so no runtime data path depended on these classes. The only breakage surface is import-time: `from anthropic.types.beta import BetaWebhookEnvironmentCreatedEventData` raises ImportError on upgrade.

fix.migration_guide: Delete imports of the removed Beta webhook event data classes (BetaWebhookEnvironment*EventData, BetaWebhookEnvironmentDeletedEventType, BetaWebhookMemoryStore*EventData) and any type annotations or isinstance checks referencing them. Because the upstream API never emitted these event payloads (they were nonfunctional type stubs), no runtime behavior depends on them: removing the annotation usage is a mechanically safe cleanup. Where an annotation is structurally required, replace with the surviving BetaWebhookEventData union or `object`. Confidence is medium because isinstance branches keyed on these classes need per-site review to confirm the branch body is dead.
fix.example_before:
from anthropic.types.beta import BetaWebhookEnvironmentCreatedEventData

def on_event(data: BetaWebhookEnvironmentCreatedEventData) -> None: ...
fix.example_after:
from anthropic.types.beta import BetaWebhookEventData

def on_event(data: BetaWebhookEventData) -> None: ...
